name: inbox.meta_hidden
description: A comment hidden on Instagram or Facebook through our own Meta app leaves the inbox, with who hid it; one whose reply is on its way is left to that reply. Internal: packages/connect, after Meta hid it.
sql: update brandbase.inbox_messages m set reply_status = 'hidden', replied_by = :actor, done_at = coalesce(m.done_at, :now::timestamptz) where m.id = :id and m.brand_id = :brand and m.reply_status is distinct from 'queued' returning jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'replyStatus', m.reply_status) as result
